validation.notes: Repaired the cross-module trust chain and verified it end-to-end with the real modules linked by .prale-eval/subject.mjs (only storage, package resolution, extension loading and the UI faked). resource-loader: loadProjectTrustExtensions now forces setProjectTrusted(false) instead of true, so the pre-consent bootstrap pass resolves only global + temporary CLI extensions. settings-manager: the disabled guard in loadFromStorage now skips project JSON when scope === 'project' && !projectTrusted, so untrusted create/reload/setProjectTrusted(false) expose {} project settings while global settings stay loaded. project-trust: resolveProjectTrusted tests trustOverride !== undefined, so an explicit false override wins immediately without emitting a project_trust extension event, prompting, or persisting consent. The script asserts observable behavior across the modules: (1) bootstrap resolve sees trusted=false and defaultModel 'global-model', the pre-trust load set is ['cli.ts','global.ts'], and the final set keeps global+CLI resources; (2) a trusted reload re-resolves with project-model, admits project.ts, and preserves nested inheritance (project reserveTokens 4096 with global keepRecentTokens 2000) without mutating global settings; (3) trustOverride=false beats a stored true decision plus an 'always' policy silently; (4) trustOverride=true decides without consent writes; (5) undefined override still honors a stored decision without prompting; (6) SettingsManager alone: untrusted create/reload skips project settings, untrusted project writes still throw, setProjectTrusted(true) admits them, dropping trust hides them again. Mutation check: restoring each production file to its faulty baseline one at a time makes the script fail on an assertion (loader/settings -> 'the pre-consent bootstrap pass must read global configuration only'; project-trust -> 'an explicit false override short-circuits the extension trust decision'); never an import error, crash or timeout. With all repairs the command exits 0. No real time, randomness, network, credentials or external services are used; async ordering is controlled by awaited promise fakes. Repository vitest/tsc runs were not used as evidence because no dependencies are installed in the workspace; the harness needs none. Temporary mutation-test copies under .prale-eval/ were removed.
